name: look-target
title: Look at a target
description: Aim the head camera at a target (turning the base if it is outside the head yaw range) and record every annotated object in view as observed.
use_when: A known target must be brought into the head camera view.

not_to_be_confused_with.inspect: inspect reports a receptacle's contents; look only aims the camera.
not_to_be_confused_with.search: search visits several places to find an unseen object.

seen.description: Objects in the head camera frustum with clear line of sight.

postconditions.meaning: Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.
The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

arg_formats.entity_ref: any annotated object, support, articulated part or button

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
